name: Costco Kirkland Bakery Giant Corn, Blueberry or Double Chocolate Muffin (Half Portion)
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale Bakery (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: Baked with fine cake flour and eggs with zero nuts or tough bran hulls; slicing a giant Costco muffin in half or quarters gives you a soft morning pastry alongside scrambled eggs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice Costco bakery muffins into halves or quarters and freeze extras; pair a half Blueberry or Corn Muffin with eggs or a banana to buffer the sugar.
watchOuts: Avoid Poppyseed Muffins (insoluble seeds); Costco's Tuxedo Chocolate Mousse Cake is very rich in heavy cream and should be eaten in small slices with lactase
